title: Office Calendars: Who Is In and Which Desks Are Free | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
An Orchard Core office calendar shows who is in the office and which desks are booked, up to the number of desks. People mark the days they are in, book a desk and register visitors, and the calendar refuses a booking that would not fit.

In this video:
• Why an office calendar, and its four kinds of events
• Setting up an office: address, contact and the number of desks
• In office, desk bookings and visitors, and what happens when the office is full
• Closing the office for a day
• What the desk count counts

chapters.title: In the office, at a desk, or a visitor
